reason.invalid_state: The area is not in a state that allows this.
reason.ambiguous_mode: More than one scenario reports this mode. Choose the scenario itself.
reason.alarm_in_progress: An alarm is in progress. Disarm before changing scenario.
reason.zone_not_bypassable: Cannot force arming: these zones may not be excluded: {zones}.

problem.duplicate_id: Two objects share the same identifier.
problem.duplicate_name: Another one already has this name.
problem.invalid_ha_state: Choose one of the Home Assistant armed states.
problem.siren_out_of_range: {field}: between 1 and 900 seconds (the EN 50131 reference for external sounders).
problem.supervision_out_of_range: {field}: between 60 seconds and 7 days, or empty for off.
problem.scenario_without_areas: A scenario must arm at least one area.
problem.unknown_area: The chosen area does not exist.
problem.unsupported_domain: This kind of entity cannot be a zone.
problem.trigger_domain: Event and tag entities need an event trigger, and only they can have one.
problem.fault_state_as_trigger: Unavailable and unknown are faults, not triggers. They always block arming.
problem.eq_hysteresis: An equality trigger has no hysteresis.
problem.event_type_required: Choose which event type triggers the zone.
problem.event_type_not_allowed: A tag has only one event, the scan: leave the type empty.
problem.key_action_required: A key zone needs an action.
problem.key_scenario_required: Choose the scenario this key arms.
problem.key_always_on: A key zone commands; it cannot be always on.
problem.key_action_not_allowed: Only key zones have a key action.
problem.always_on_must_be_instant: An always-on zone fires at once: no entry delay applies.
problem.auto_bypass_needs_bypassable: Automatic exclusion needs a zone that may be excluded.
problem.hold_needs_arm_after_closing: The wait limit applies only to “arm after closing”.
problem.area_not_disarmed: This area is not disarmed. Disarm it before changing what protects it.
problem.scenario_active: This scenario is running. Disarm before editing it.
problem.trigger_not_confirmed: Confirm the trigger states against the real sensor first.
problem.not_found: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
problem.area_has_zones: Move or delete this area's zones first.
problem.area_in_scenario: Remove this area from its scenarios first.
problem.scenario_in_use: A key zone arms this scenario. Change the key zone first.
problem.follows_needs_follower: Only a follower zone can follow other zones.
problem.follows_not_delayed: A follower can follow only delayed intrusion zones.
problem.request_failed: Home Assistant did not accept the request ({detail}). Nothing was changed. Reload the page and try again.
problem.area_has_groups: A verification group is shown in this area. Move or delete it first.
problem.zone_in_group: This zone is a member of a verification group. Remove it from the group first.
problem.zone_is_cross_partner: Another zone uses this one for cross-zone verification. Change that zone first.
problem.cross_zone_window_mismatch: Both zones of this pair point at each other with different windows. Give them the same window.
problem.group_members: A group needs at least two different members.
problem.group_member_invalid: Only existing intrusion zones can be members.
problem.group_threshold: The threshold must be at least 2 and no more than the number of members.
problem.zone_in_two_groups: A zone can belong to one group or cross-zone pair only, or it would count twice.
problem.technical_always_on: A technical zone is always live: it must be always on.
problem.chime_always_on: An always-on zone is always watched, so it can never chime.
problem.chime_target_invalid: The chime plays on media players and sirens only.
problem.chime_tts_required: Speaking the zone name needs a text-to-speech entity.
problem.chime_sound_required: Media players need a sound to play: set the media to play.
problem.quiet_hours_incomplete: Quiet hours need both a start and an end.
problem.unknown_profile: That response profile does not exist.
problem.camera_dir_invalid: Use a folder inside the configuration directory, never www: it is served without authentication.
problem.severity_out_of_range: Severity is a number from 1 to 10.
problem.moments_required: Choose at least one moment for this action.
problem.too_many_conditions: An action carries at most two conditions.
problem.empty_window: A window that starts when it ends never applies.
problem.condition_entity_invalid: Choose an entity and the state to compare it with.
problem.unknown_variable: {field} uses a variable that does not exist.
problem.notify_service_required: Choose a notify service or notify entity.
problem.service_required: Give a domain and a service.
problem.data_invalid: Service data must be a mapping.
problem.entity_required: Choose at least one entity for {field}.
problem.entity_domain: {field} points at an entity this action cannot use.
problem.camera_mode_invalid: Choose a snapshot or a recording.
problem.brightness_out_of_range: Brightness is a number from 0 to 255.
problem.profile_in_use: Something still uses this profile. Point it elsewhere first.

field.name: Name
field.arm_hold_timeout: Wait for it to close, at most
field.suppress_members: Members produce nothing below the threshold
field.title: Title

entry_mode_hint.instant: Triggers the alarm at once when the area is armed.
entry_mode_hint.delayed: Starts the entry delay: the way in, such as the front door.
entry_mode_hint.follower: Inherits a running entry delay — its own area's, or one opened by a zone it follows; instant otherwise.

arm_policy_hint.block: Arming fails and names this zone.
arm_policy_hint.auto_bypass: Excluded and announced; it rejoins by itself once closed.
arm_policy_hint.arm_after_closing: Arming waits, after the exit delay, until it closes. It fails if it stays open too long.
arm_policy_hint.ignore: Arms regardless. It fires the next time it opens.

overview.no_codes_warning: No users or codes yet: anyone with access to Home Assistant can disarm. Codes arrive in a later update.
overview.memory_banner: Alarm memory in {area}: {zones}. Disarm the area to clear it.
overview.scenario_hint: Choosing a scenario arms its areas. While armed, it switches: areas not in the new one are disarmed.
overview.force_arm_hint: Excludes the zones above and records the arming as forced.
overview.technical_banner: Technical alarm: {zones}. A separate channel: arming does not affect it and disarming does not clear it. It clears once acknowledged and back to normal.
overview.incident_acknowledged: Acknowledged — it closes once every area is disarmed or armed again
overview.incident_hint: One incident gathers every zone of one alarm. Disarming also acknowledges it.

areas.title: Areas
areas.reports_as_hint: What voice assistants and HomeKit see. Changes nothing about behaviour.
areas.entry_hint: For zones that do not set their own.
areas.exit_hint: Time to leave after arming, unless the scenario sets its own.

zones.title: Zones
zones.no_areas: Create an area first: every zone belongs to one.
zones.entity_hint: Any sensor, contact, cover, lock, switch, person, event or tag.
zones.state_hint: Normally-closed and normally-open contacts behave in opposite ways. Open the door or walk past and watch the state.
zones.hysteresis_hint: How far back it must go before it counts as normal again.
zones.attribute_hint: Read this attribute instead of the state.
zones.tag_hint: A tag fires every time it is scanned.
zones.event_hint: Only this event triggers the zone.
zones.confirm: I have checked this against the real sensor
zones.confirm_hint: A wrong choice is a zone that never fires, found out during a break-in.
zones.type_hint: A preset: it fills the fields below, which all stay editable.
zones.hold_hint: Empty: the global default. Counted from the end of the exit delay.
zones.supervision_hint: Silent longer than this is a fault; any report counts, even without a change. Set it longer than this sensor's own reporting interval. Empty: off, which is the default and right for sensors that report only when they change.
zones.bypassable_hint: Needed for automatic or forced exclusion.
zones.allow_faulted_hint: Arming proceeds even if this zone cannot be seen. Leave off unless you know why.
zones.enabled_hint: A disabled zone is ignored completely.
zones.key_hint: A key arms or disarms as a person would. It never alarms.
zones.area_armed: This zone's area is armed: changes are refused until it is disarmed.
zones.follows_hint: Its own area's entry delay always counts. Tick the delayed zones of other areas whose entry delay it should also inherit, such as the front door for a hall sensor in an interior area.
zones.fire_statement: Foyer is not a fire alarm system. A smoke or gas detector connected to Home Assistant does not replace certified, interconnected smoke alarms.
zones.technical_hint: A technical zone raises the technical alarm whatever the areas are doing. It never triggers an area and disarming never clears it. Save it while the detector is quiet: a detector already detecting when saved counts as its starting point and alarms only once it has returned to normal and detects again.
zones.cross_zone_hint: Another zone that confirms this one within the window. Each still alarms on its own; when both detect, the pair is recorded as confirmed. Set it on either zone.
zones.trigger_count_hint: How many times it must detect within the window before it alarms. 1: at once. Only detections that would alarm at once are counted: opening the entry route is not.
zones.chime_hint: Plays the chime when it opens while its area is not armed.
zones.in_group: Member of the verification group {group}. Change it on the Verification groups page.
zones.bypass_hint: An excluded zone does not alarm. Without a duration it comes back when the area is disarmed; with one it comes back on its own, and says so.
zones.silent_hint: The response runs without the sounders the settings list.
zones.profile_hint: Read only when this zone alarms. Empty: the area's profile.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.shared_mode: Shared with another scenario: the master cannot arm this mode.
scenarios.mode_hint: Several scenarios may share one; the master then refuses that mode and the scenario is chosen here.
scenarios.exit_hint: Empty: each area's own exit delay.
scenarios.siren_hint: At most 900 s. Empty: the global setting.
scenarios.areas_hint: Only these are armed. Switching to another scenario disarms the areas it does not list.

card.no_entity: Set an entity: a Foyer alarm_control_panel.

help.global_toggle: Show or hide every help panel

overview.title: What this page shows
overview.intro: The live state of the alarm. It updates by itself; every button acts at once.

area.text: Arms and disarms on its own. Its button arms only that area.

master.text: Derived from the areas: armed if any is. Disarm here disarms everything.

scenario.text: Arms a set of areas. Chosen while armed, it switches.

not_ready.text: Open, faulted or excluded zones. Faults block arming unless the zone allows it.

memory.text: Stays after the sounders stop, until someone disarms.

technical.text: Smoke, gas, water: its own channel. Disarming does not clear it; acknowledge it.

incident.text: Every zone of one alarm, acknowledged once.

areas.title: What an area is
areas.intro: A group of zones armed together, with its own state and alarm panel entity. Group by what you arm together — perimeter, interior day, interior night — not by room: that is what makes "dog at home, perimeter only" possible.

own_state.text: Each area arms, delays and alarms independently.

entry.text: Longer gives you more time to disarm, and an intruder the same.

exit.text: Zones still open when it ends are handled by their own arm policy.

reports_as.text: What Home Assistant, HomeKit and voice assistants see. Behaviour is unchanged.

zones.title: What a zone is
zones.intro: One Home Assistant entity plus alarm semantics. The type is only a preset; the engine reads the fields.

trigger.text: Which state means an alarm. Get it wrong and the zone never fires.

type.text: Fills the fields below. Every field stays editable.

entry_mode.text: Instant alarms at once; delayed starts the entry delay; follower inherits it.

arm_policy.text: Block names the zone; exclude lets it rejoin once closed; ignore arms anyway.

hold.text: Waits for the door you leave by. Fails if it stays open past the limit.

always_on.text: Fires even when disarmed. Tamper and panic are always on.

supervision.text: A sensor silent too long is a fault, never “all quiet”.

verification.text: Cross-zone and activations needed cut false alarms; a group does it for several zones.

scenarios.title: What a scenario is
scenarios.intro: A named set of areas to arm together. Create as many as the house needs.

areas.text: Exactly these are armed by it.

reports_master.text: The mode HomeKit and voice assistants see. A mode shared by two scenarios cannot be armed from the master.

switching.text: Choosing another scenario while armed disarms the areas it does not list.

exit_override.text: Replaces each area's own for this scenario.

siren.text: A night scenario may sound for less. Never more than 900 s.

groups.title: What a verification group is
groups.intro: A group confirms an alarm when at least N of its member zones detect within a window: the strongest tool against false alarms in large spaces. A zone's cross-zone field is the same engine, as a 2-of-2 group.

threshold.text: How many members, within how long. A longer window is easier to satisfy.

members.text: Any intrusion zone, in any area. Opening the entry route never counts.

suppress.text: Off by default: each member still alarms alone. On: nothing until the group is satisfied.

derived.text: Cross-zone pairs, shown here and edited on the zone.

settings.title: What these settings do
settings.intro: Settings that apply to the whole installation: the chime, and where every response chain ends.

targets.text: Where the chime sounds. Nothing chimes until one is set.

mode.text: A sound, or the zone's name spoken, which tells you what opened.

quiet.text: No chime inside this window. A target may carry a window of its own.

during_exit.text: Whether zones chime while their area counts down to armed.

response.text: The profile everything inherits, the one the technical channel uses, and what a silent zone keeps quiet.

profiles.title: What a response profile is
profiles.intro: A profile is a named list of actions: what happens, when, and under which conditions. The area is the unit of response; a zone's own profile is read only for its own alarm, which is what makes a verification group's graduated response work.

inheritance.text: Zone, then area, then scenario, then the global default. The page shows the effective profile and where it comes from.

moments.text: One action can answer several moments. Some moments arrive with a later phase and are marked.

conditions.text: At most two per action, combined with and or or. More than that belongs in a Home Assistant automation.

severity.text: Only decides which escalation an incident adopts when profiles of different strength contribute to it.

silent.text: A zone marked silent runs its response without the action kinds the settings name.

armed_area.title: Foyer: armed
armed_area.message: {area} armed on its own, outside any scenario.

arm_failed.title: Foyer: arming failed
arm_failed.message: {area} did not arm. Still open or in fault: {zones}. It is disarmed.

zone_bypassed.title: Foyer: zone excluded
zone_bypassed.message: {zone} was open at arming and is excluded. It rejoins by itself once it closes.

zone_rejoined.title: Foyer: zone back in
zone_rejoined.message: {zone} has closed and is protected again.

entry_started.title: Foyer: entry delay
entry_started.message: {zone} opened in {area}. Disarm before the delay ends.

siren_cutoff.title: Foyer: sounders stopped
siren_cutoff.message: The alarm in {area} is over; the area is back to its previous state. Disarm to clear the alarm memory.

zone_fault.title: Foyer: zone fault
zone_fault.message: Zone {zone} in {area} cannot be seen. It blocks arming until it is seen again.

ha_restarted.title: Foyer: back online
ha_restarted.message: Foyer was not running for a while. The house was not protected during that time.

technical_raised.title: Foyer: TECHNICAL ALARM
technical_raised.message: {zone} in {area} detects a technical alarm. Disarming does not clear it: acknowledge it once it is safe. Foyer is not a fire alarm system.

technical_acknowledged.title: Foyer: technical alarm acknowledged
technical_acknowledged.message: Acknowledged: {zones}. It clears once back to normal.

technical_cleared.title: Foyer: technical alarm cleared
technical_cleared.message: {zone} is back to normal and acknowledged.

chime_switched.title: Foyer: chime
chime_switched.message: The chime was switched on or off.

code_rejected.title: Foyer: code rejected
code_rejected.message: A wrong code was entered on {channel}.

lockout.title: Foyer: locked out
lockout.message: Too many wrong codes on {channel}. That channel is locked.

walk_test_started.title: Foyer: walk test
walk_test_started.message: A walk test has started. Response actions are inhibited.

walk_test_ended.title: Foyer: walk test over
walk_test_ended.message: The walk test has ended. The system responds normally again.

escalation_exhausted.title: Foyer: nobody answered
escalation_exhausted.message: The escalation reached its last step without an acknowledgement.

technical_state.acknowledged: Acknowledged, not back to normal yet

groups.title: Verification groups
groups.from_zone_hint: Cross-zone pairs appear here as 2-of-2 groups. They are edited on the zone, not here.
groups.members_hint: Intrusion zones of any area. A member counts only while its own area is armed, and only detections that would alarm at once count.
groups.suppress_hint: Off: each member still alarms on its own, and the group adds its confirmation. On: members do nothing until the group is satisfied — a single sensor facing a real intruder then produces silence.
groups.window_hint: Seconds within which the members must detect.
groups.no_zones: No intrusion zones available: each zone can be in one group or pair only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.chime_intro: Sounds when a zone with the chime switched on opens while its area is not armed — not merely when the house is disarmed. With only the perimeter armed, an internal door still chimes.
settings.targets_hint: Media players, sirens, and notify services or entities — the phone and Telegram chime too. Each target may carry quiet hours of its own.
settings.no_targets: No media player or siren found.
settings.sound_hint: For media players: a media id or URL, such as media-source://media_source/local/chime.mp3. A siren sounds for one second, if it supports a set duration; otherwise it is skipped.
settings.tts_hint: Used to speak the zone name.
settings.volume_hint: Percent. Empty: leave the player's volume as it is.
settings.quiet_hint: No chime in this window, which may cross midnight. Empty: never quiet.
settings.during_exit_hint: Off: the door you leave by does not chime while the area counts down.
settings.switch_hint: switch.foyer_chime silences it without changing these settings.
settings.later: The other settings arrive in a later update.
settings.response_intro: Where every inheritance chain ends, and what a silent zone keeps quiet.
settings.default_profile_hint: What every area, zone and scenario inherits unless it overrides it.
settings.technical_profile_hint: Smoke, gas and flood answer with this one, whatever the house is doing. Empty: the default profile.
settings.silent_hint: A zone marked silent runs its response without these.
settings.camera_dir_hint: Inside the configuration folder. Never www, which is served without authentication.

condition.midnight_hint: A window may cross midnight: 22:00 to 07:00 is the night.
condition.max: At most two conditions per action. Anything more belongs in a Home Assistant automation subscribed to foyer_event.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.intro: A profile is a reusable list of actions. It resolves by inheritance — zone, then area, then scenario, then the global default — which is what stops a house of sixteen zones turning into a configuration matrix.
profiles.severity_hint: Used for one thing only: when several zones join one incident, the incident adopts the escalation of the highest-severity profile among them. It changes nothing when this profile runs alone.
profiles.zone_hint: A zone's own profile is read only for its own alarm. Everything else in this area answers with the area's profile.
profiles.group_hint: What a satisfied group does. Its members keep their own profile: that is what makes the response graduated.
profiles.delay_hint: Holds the actions after it in this list. It survives a restart.
profiles.revert_hint: Empty: leave it as it is.
profiles.camera_hint: The notification attaches the live picture; the file is written to the camera folder.
profiles.call_service_hint: Anything Foyer does not model natively. Data is JSON.
profiles.escalation_later: Escalation across contacts arrives in Phase 4.
profiles.future_moment: Raised from a later phase on.
profiles.attach_hint: The live picture goes with the notification, through Home Assistant's authenticated proxy. No file is written.
